treatment.name: Scaling & Polishing
treatment.overview: Professional cleaning removes plaque, tartar, and stains to keep gums healthy and breath fresh.

types.name: Basic Scaling
description: Ultrasonic cleaning of tartar above the gumline.
Polishing to smooth tooth surfaces and reduce stain buildup.

types.name: Deep Cleaning (Full Mouth)
description: Scaling and root planing for gum pockets.

cost.note: Price varies with tartar/stain levels and gum condition.

after: Improved gum health and fresher breath.

avoid: Extremely hot/cold foods for the first day if sensitivity occurs
prefer: Lukewarm, soft foods if gums feel tender
foodGuidelines.tip: Use a desensitizing toothpaste if sensitivity persists.

pros: No clinic visit or cost in the short term
cons: Tartar buildup leading to gum disease and bad breath
Higher risk of tooth mobility and bone loss
prosConsOfSkipping.summary: Regular scaling (about every 6 months) prevents gum disease and keeps your smile healthy.

faq.q: How often should I get scaling?
faq.a: Every 6 months, or more often if advised for gum issues.
No—scaling removes harmful deposits; it helps protect teeth and gums.
